title: Preparing Worms for the COPAS (Wormsorter)
author: Priota Islam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfqbjmsn

steps.title: Wash worms from plates
steps.instruction: Wash the worms off the plates using a few milliliters of M9 and collect them in a 15ml falcon tube, filling up to 15ml with M9.

steps.title: Perform sequential washes
steps.instruction: Wash the worm pellet three times in total using the following cycle:

substeps.instruction: Remove the supernatant using a pasteur pipette.

steps.title: Prepare final worm suspension
steps.instruction: After the final wash, remove the supernatant, leaving approximately 10ml in the falcon tube.

steps.title: Consolidate and dilute worms
steps.instruction: Consolidate all the worm liquid into a 50ml tube and dilute if necessary for the COPAS.

steps.title: Dispense worms via COPAS
steps.instruction: Dispense the worms using the COPAS following the COPAS wormsorter protocol.
